devdoc.author: AML Detection System
devdoc.details: Security notes:      - Follows checks-effects-interactions ordering throughout.      - No raw ETH is moved by this contract; "amount" is a logged value        used purely for risk scoring and record-keeping, so there is no        reentrancy surface from external calls.      - All admin-only entry points are gated by the `onlyOwner` modifier.      - All numeric bounds (risk scores, thresholds) are validated on        every write path, never trusted from calldata alone.      - Solidity 0.8.19 has built-in overflow/underflow checks, so no        SafeMath library is required.

registerUser(string).details: New users start unverified, not blacklisted, with a neutral      starting risk score of 50 (mid-scale, since there is no history      yet to justify a low score).

submitTransaction(address,uint256).details: No ETH is moved — `amount` is a logged value used for risk      scoring. The transaction's risk score and status are computed      automatically and immutably at submission time:        - If the receiver is blacklisted, the transaction is Rejected          outright regardless of score.        - Otherwise, a 0-100 score is computed from the amount and          both parties' standing; scores at/above the current          suspicious threshold are Flagged, otherwise Approved.

params.amount: Value of the transaction, for scoring/record purposes.
params.receiver: Address the funds/value are logically directed to.

returns.id: The id assigned to the newly created transaction.

params.newScore: New risk score, must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
params.user: Address whose score is being updated.

params.newThreshold: New threshold, must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.

flaggedTransactionsCount.details: Running count of transactions currently flagged as suspicious.

nextTransactionId.details: Running counter used to assign the next transaction id.

totalTransactionsCount.details: Running count of total transactions submitted (== nextTransactionId, exposed via getter for clarity).

documentation.text:
@title AMLSystem
 @author AML Detection System
 @notice An on-chain Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection system.
         Registers users, tracks their verification/risk/blacklist status,
         accepts transaction records between addresses, automatically
         computes a 0-100 risk score for each transaction, and flags any
         transaction whose score meets or exceeds a configurable
         suspicious-activity threshold.
 @dev Security notes:
      - Follows checks-effects-interactions ordering throughout.
      - No raw ETH is moved by this contract; "amount" is a logged value
        used purely for risk scoring and record-keeping, so there is no
        reentrancy surface from external calls.
      - All admin-only entry points are gated by the `onlyOwner` modifier.
      - All numeric bounds (risk scores, thresholds) are validated on
        every write path, never trusted from calldata alone.
      - Solidity 0.8.19 has built-in overflow/underflow checks, so no
        SafeMath library is required.

@dev Computes a deterministic 0-100 risk score for a prospective
      transaction. Pure function of on-chain state, so it can never
      be gamed by anything off-chain (like randomness or timestamps
      beyond what's already used for other purposes).
      Scoring breakdown (weights sum to a maximum of 100):
        - Amount tier:            up to 40 points
        - Sender/receiver risk:   up to 50 points (avg of both, scaled)
        - Verification penalty:   up to 20 points (10 each if unverified)
      The raw sum is capped at 100.
